en: The front of the postcard depicts a hand-colored photograph of a scenic view with a notable church spire rising above town rooftops, lush trees, and a pavilion-like structure, surrounded by a decorative border. The caption underneath the image reads 'PYRMONT, STAHLBRUNNENQUELLE.' The back of the postcard uses German language and includes printed lines for the address, the word 'Postkarte,' and a blue stamp from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
